## Experience

- Senior Software Engineer, ElkTech, Lahore — March 2026 to present.
  Uses Claude Code, Claude AI and GitHub Copilot to analyse large codebases,
  implement complex features, debug production issues and support architectural
  decisions. Leads code reviews and mentors juniors in an Agile/Scrum team.
- Software Engineer, Sixlogics, Lahore — July 2023 to February 2026.
  Architected high-traffic live sports platforms (Racing and Sports UK, Betway
  Scores, Hollywood Bets Live Scores) serving 100K+ daily active users. Built
  with Next.js, React 18, TypeScript and NestJS for a 40% page-load improvement.
  Implemented Apache Kafka streaming with sub-second latency. Raised organic
  traffic 60% via JSON-LD structured data and dynamic XML sitemaps.
- Associate Software Engineer, The Dev Corporate, Lahore — September 2022 to March 2023.
- Angular Development Trainee, ICOMMUNIX, Lahore — June to July 2022.
- Ruby on Rails Intern, Devsinc, Lahore — January to March 2022.
